source: Saifudeen et al., Nat. Biotechnol. (2026), doi:10.1038/s41587-026-03090-8
license_policy: local analysis only; no repackaged or adapted derivative value matrices committed; commit downloaders, code, hashes, schemas and value-free summaries only

verified_claims.wt_metadata_gap: S4 carries 409 WT activity columns but S2 lists 392 WT metadata rows; 17 WT constructs lack metadata in the committed table
verified_claims.variant_metadata_gap: S13 carries 349 variant columns; S11 lists 347 rows (2 variants lack metadata rows, one row has an empty Mutation field)
verified_claims.Km_ATP: per-kinase Km ATP per supplementary methods (verified in MOESM1 methods; record with access date)
verified_claims.endpoint: percent residual activity at 1 uM (functional inhibition; NOT affinity: never called pK/pIC50/DTA)

pairability_census.note: exact construct-background equality between WT and variant rows is NOT assumed: S2/S11 Clone fields differ across constructs (full-length vs fragments); a construct-matched pairability layer requires per-pair Clone comparison and is reported as a separate unresolved dimension

activity_structure.responsive_window_definition: fraction of the 92 inhibitor values strictly inside (20, 80)

limitations: single-dose functional inhibition: Hill slope / top / bottom / efficacy are not identifiable from one concentration; logit transform of % residual is a sensitivity analysis only, not pIC50
construct background differences between WT and variant rows are a confound to be modeled explicitly in B1, not assumed away
vendor/platform uniformity does not imply assay-semantics uniformity; per-kinase ATP and substrate must be read from S2/S11 columns
